en.html:
It turned inside out.

Round and round, the armor folded itself inward.
The flesh within folded with it.

...Round and round.
...Sinking, sinking.

Rolled up like paper craft, it became one beautiful, perfectly beautiful silver sphere.

Then it inverted once more.

Round and round, it spread outward.
Extended limbs.

Produced a neck.
Raised a back.

At length there appeared the original human shape.

But the body was one size smaller.
Its appearance was entirely different.

Glossy black hair.
A young and lovely face.
Silver armor—

A girl of silver.
